record.material_as_written: glassy Li3 OCl- and Na3 OCl-based antiperovskites
record.evidence_quote: glassy Li3 OCl- and Na3 OCl-based antiperovskites have shown remarkable conductivities of approximately ∼0.1 mS/cm at room temperature, with glass transition temperatures between 390 and 450 K [18–20].
record.notes: Literature value cited from refs 18-20 for a mixed Li/Na class of glassy antiperovskites, not a single composition; mobile ion recorded as other because both Li and Na are included. Not measured in this paper.

record.material_as_written: Li6.75 La3 Zr1.75 Ta0.25 O12 @amorphous Li3 OCl composite
record.evidence_quote: resulting in high room-temperature conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm and an extensive electrochemical stability window up to 10 V.
record.notes: Literature value for an LLZTO/amorphous Li3OCl composite from refs 21-24 (the quote does not name the composite; it is identified from the preceding sentence about Li6.75La3Zr1.75Ta0.25O12 with amorphous Li3OCl). Not measured in this paper.
